parole.significato: A resinous substance or lacquer produced mainly on the banyan tree by the female of Kerria lacca, a scale insect.
parole.testo: From Portuguese laca, from Hindi लाख (lākh)/Urdu لاکھ (lākh) or cognates in other Indo-Aryan languages, from Sanskrit लाक्षा (lākṣā). Doublet of lacquer.
